title: pycompose.toml
description: An app's whole configuration: the Android project is generated from it (plan 31 §21.4).

app.description: The app's identity, written once for every platform.

application_id.description: The store identity, a reverse domain name such as com.example.notes.

version_name.description: The version people see, such as 1.2.0.

version_code.description: The version stores compare: a whole number that grows with every release.

icon.description: One SVG on the adaptive icon's 108-unit grid.

icon_background.description: The launcher icon's background colour, as #RRGGBB.

python.description: Where the app's Python lives and what it installs.

entrypoint.description: module:object naming the app's App, such as main:app.

source_dir.description: The directory holding the app's Python, relative to this file.

requirements.description: Packages installed into the app at build time, as pip requirement specifiers.

resources.description: Strings, images and files the app ships.

path.description: The resources directory, relative to this file.

theme.description: The app's Material theme: colours, dark mode, fonts and corner shapes.

colors.description: A Material Theme Builder export whose schemes.light and schemes.dark map colour roles to #RRGGBB.

dynamic.description: Prefer the wallpaper's colours on Android 12+; on by default without colors, off with them.

dark.description: Dark mode: system, light or dark.

fonts.description: Fonts from resources/fonts, by file name without the extension.

display.description: The font for display, headline and title styles.

body.description: The font for body and label styles.

shapes.description: Corner radii in dp for Material's five shape sizes.

extra_small.description: The extra small corner radius in dp.

small.description: The small corner radius in dp.

medium.description: The medium corner radius in dp.

large.description: The large corner radius in dp.

extra_large.description: The extra large corner radius in dp.

signing.description: Release signing: names of environment variables, never the secrets themselves.

key_alias.description: The key's alias in the keystore.

store_password_env.description: The environment variable holding the keystore password.

key_password_env.description: The environment variable holding the key password.

permissions.description: Permissions the app asks for, such as android.permission.INTERNET: explicit consent, never derived.

plugins.description: Build plugins from installed packages, run in this order.

toolchain.description: Which PyCompose and wire schema the app was written against.

library_version.description: The oldest PyCompose the app needs.

schema_version.description: The wire schema the app speaks.

template_version.description: An app-owned Android project's template version; generated projects need none.

android_dir.description: Where the Android project lives: .pycompose/android when generated, . when the app owns it.
